episode1Synopsis.title: Module 1: The Broth — Extraction, Clarity & Heat Control
episode1Synopsis.duration: 15 min (3 Chapters · Chapter 1 Live Proof: 5 min)
episode1Synopsis.logline: Chef Lila Mensah teaches heat management, aromatics, and skimming discipline through a crystal-clear foundation broth that powers the rest of the curriculum.
episode1Synopsis.synopsis: In Module 1, Chef Lila Mensah establishes the Harbor Street workbench and teaches the foundational skill of the course: transforming cold water, roasted bones or root vegetables, and aromatics into a clear, structured broth. Structured into three instructional chapters—(1) Cold Start & Knife Mise en Place, (2) The Convection Simmer & Skim, and (3) Late-Stage Salt Calibration & Clarity Check—learners master thermal control before touching flour or roast proteins in later modules.
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Title: Chapter 1: Cold Water, Clean Bones & The First Simmer
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Synopsis: Opening on A-Cam in the daylight-balanced Harbor Street Kitchen, Chef Lila Mensah introduces the five-plate syllabus, switches to a locked 90° overhead B-Cam to demonstrate uniform mirepoix cuts and cold-water submersion, and brings the stockpot to its first lazy convection bubble alongside apprentices Marcus and Priya.

episodes.title: The Broth
episodes.synopsis: Lila starts with a clear broth: knife, bones or vegetables, heat, and patience. She shows the simmer, the skim, and the moment salt goes in. The kitchen, the coat, and her face are established as the locked set. The check is a spoonful that tastes finished, not cloudy.

episodes.title: The Bread
episodes.synopsis: Same bench, same chef. Dough, time, and the feel of a proved loaf. Lila ties the broth’s lesson about patience to the wait the dough requires. Students shape, score, and bake. The check is a crumb that is open, not gummy, and a note on what they would change next time.

episodes.title: The Vegetable Main
episodes.synopsis: A pan of greens and grains that has to feed the whole class, not a camera. Lila shows a sauce built from the broth, seasoning for a group, and how to hold color in the vegetables. The check is a plate that is the same in the first bowl and the last.

episodes.title: The Celebration Roast
episodes.synopsis: A center plate for a night that matters: roast, rest, and a side that uses yesterday’s bread. Lila keeps the same station and the same voice while the stakes of the plate go up. The check is carving for a table, not a single hero shot.

episodes.title: The Last Sweet
episodes.synopsis: A dessert that needs the heat control of module 1, the timing of module 2, and the seasoning eye of module 3. Then the class sets all five plates as one meal. Lila walks the pass in the same coat, in the same kitchen. The course turns from lessons into a service.

howWeScore.description: Audience Resonance menggabungkan analisis struktur naratif (kejelasan, rentak, lengkok emosi) dengan kesesuaian persona sasaran berdasarkan audiens yang anda tentukan dalam Blueprint — bukannya metrik dangkal atau data pengekalan selepas penerbitan. Apabila deskripsi audiens anda mengandungi unsur budaya, analisis ini turut menilai aspek ketulenan dari segi nama, dialek, adat resam, kepercayaan, dan sensitiviti. Cadangan yang diberikan dikaitkan dengan bahagian skrip tertentu, membolehkan anda membetulkan isu sebelum ejen memulakan proses penjanaan video.
bullets: Menilai Blueprint dan skrip berdasarkan khalayak sasaran yang telah anda tetapkan.
Semakan ketulenan budaya terhadap nama, dialek, adat resam, kepercayaan, dan perkara sensitif
Cadangan pada peringkat bahagian — bukan sekadar angka "percayalah kepada kami" yang tidak telus
Jalankan sebelum menanggung kos 'render' yang berat, bukan selepas penerbitan.

express.title: SceneFlow Agents
express.description: Audio Agent, Stills Agent, dan Video Agent menyusun arahan (prompt) pakar berdasarkan panduan rentak, melampirkan rujukan yang tepat, serta menjana hasil secara serentak. Sesuatu babak mungkin mengambil masa beberapa minit kerana ejen tersebut melaksanakan tugas khusus — kemudian, anda meluluskan Shot Frames sebelum membuat perbelanjaan untuk video bergerak.

items.title: Pre-vis Agent
items.desc: Lengkap dengan rakaman suara dan skor muzik mengikut rentak bagi setiap babak, dihasilkan berdasarkan arahan yang telah dimuktamadkan, serta sedia untuk dikongsi di Screening Room.

preVisEngine.title: SFAIPRE_ISTILAH_ENJIN_PENGVISUALAN
preVisEngine.subtitle: Menghasilkan Pre-Vis (istilah industri: *animatic*) berdurasi 40 minit yang lengkap dengan suara dan muzik latar dalam masa 15 minit bukanlah sekadar satu langkah aliran kerja — ia adalah produk itu sendiri. Di Hollywood, proses *pre-vis* mengambil masa berminggu-minggu dan menelan kos ratusan ribu dolar. SceneFlow membolehkan proses ini disiapkan dalam masa beberapa minit sahaja dengan kos yang sangat rendah.
preVisEngine.narrative: Dalam industri perfileman, papan cerita ialah sesuatu yang diserahkan kepada kru. Pre-vis pula ialah bahan yang ditunjukkan kepada eksekutif studio, pelabur, dan penerbit bagi mendapatkan kelulusan untuk memulakan projek. SceneFlow meningkatkan taraf produksi daripada sekadar alat untuk pencipta pengguna kepada aset aliran kerja bertaraf perusahaan.

pillars.title: Pitch Deck Terbaik
pillars.description: Muat naik skrip dan hadiri mesyuarat pembentangan idea dengan visual pratonton (pre-vis) yang lengkap dengan alih suara, muzik latar serta sokongan pelbagai bahasa, ditambah pula dengan data kukuh daripada Audience Resonance. Berikan pencipta satu "jalan pintas" audio-visual yang disokong oleh data untuk merealisasikan pembikinan filem mereka.

pillars.title: Pra-pengeluaran Gagal-Cepat
pillars.description: Pra-visualisasi tradisional memerlukan animator 3D, artis papan cerita, dan pelakon suara untuk tempoh berminggu-minggu. Jika sesuatu babak tidak menjadi, wang berjumlah puluhan ribu dolar akan terbazir. Lakukan lelaran dalam masa 15 minit sebelum seorang pun kru kamera diambil bekerja.

pillars.title: Analitik Kewangan
pillars.description: Audience Resonance pada peringkat muat naik menarik minat pihak dalam industri yang paling mengelak risiko: pembiaya. Tunjukkan bagaimana rentak, nada, dan dialog selaras dengan demografi sasaran sebelum satu dolar pun dibelanjakan untuk produksi.

workflow.title: Reference Library → Pra-visualisasi → Video Gerak → Master ProRes 4K
steps: Bina Reference Library — watak, lokasi, dan prop yang ditetapkan mengikut gaya seni produksi anda.
Hasilkan bingkai visualisasi awal (pre-vis) bagi setiap babak yang merangkumi dialog, kesan bunyi (SFX), dan muzik — serta lakukan penambahbaikan arahan di Screening Room pada kos yang rendah.

blueprint.subtitle: Transform your raw concept into a greenlit, 80+ Resonance film treatment before spending production credits.

quickSteps.title: Generate Your Film Treatment
quickSteps.description: Enter your story concept or script and generate a complete 3-act Film Treatment with hero key art.

quickSteps.title: Run Audience Resonance™ Analysis
quickSteps.description: Evaluate your story against your target demographic across 5 narrative axes and identify weak beats.

quickSteps.title: Apply 1-Click Fixes to Reach 80+ Score
quickSteps.description: Apply the AI script doctor recommendations until your Resonance score reaches 80/100 or higher.

quickSteps.title: Greenlight into Virtual Production
quickSteps.description: Lock the Blueprint and generate your scene-by-scene screenplay, cast list, and visual breakdown.

production.subtitle: Lock character faces & voices in the Continuity Vault, render start/end keyframes, and animate motion video clips.

quickSteps.title: Lock Cast Portraits, Voices & Locations First
quickSteps.description: Generate and approve character portraits, neural voices, and location references in the Reference Library.

quickSteps.title: Synthesize Dialogue, SFX & Musical Score
quickSteps.description: Assign voices to each character and generate scene dialogue and atmosphere so your timeline timing is locked.

quickSteps.title: Render Start/End Keyframes & Preview Animatic
quickSteps.description: Generate reference-locked keyframes for each segment and watch the full film in the Screening Room as an Animatic.

quickSteps.title: Animate Hero Shots or Launch Production Agent
quickSteps.description: Convert key shots into motion video manually, or launch the autonomous Production Agent to build Pre-Vis, Clips, Master, and Promo while you walk away.

series.subtitle: Build multi-episode shows or chapter-by-chapter adaptations with one shared cast & location vault.

quickSteps.title: Create or Select Your Series Bible
quickSteps.description: Enter your series logline, genre, and target episode count to generate a multi-episode story arc and shared cast.

quickSteps.title: Lock Recurring Characters & Locations
quickSteps.description: Approve the reference portraits and voice assignments in the Series Bible so every episode inherits them automatically.

quickSteps.title: Launch Episode 1 into Blueprint Room
quickSteps.description: Click "Launch Episode Blueprint" on Episode 1 to refine its 3-act treatment and start Virtual Production.

final-cut.subtitle: Blend Animatic & Video streams, switch across 13+ dubbed languages, and share /s/ review links.

quickSteps.title: Watch Full-Screen in the Screening Room
quickSteps.description: Play your assembled scenes back-to-back with transitions, dialogue, SFX, and auto-ducked score.

quickSteps.title: Share a /s/ Review Link for Feedback
quickSteps.description: Generate a shareable screening link to collect timestamped notes from collaborators or clients.

quickSteps.title: Export MP4 Master & Multi-Language Dubs
quickSteps.description: Render your final 1080p/4K MP4 master and optional localized audio/subtitle streams.
